name: Otter AI
description: Otter.ai offers an API, webhooks and an MCP server, but the sources document no developer API details.
auth_notes: Credential type for the Otter.ai API is not stated in any source; the Otter docs in the sources describe a different restaurant product.
gate_detail: The pricing page lists Otter API and Webhooks under the Enterprise plan, which is custom priced with a demo request. Free Basic plan lists an Otter MCP server.
api_scope: Not documented in the sources; pricing page only lists Otter API and Webhooks as an Enterprise feature.
mcp_notes: Pricing page lists an Otter MCP server on the Basic plan and MCP server integration for AI assistants; no URL or docs shown.
blocker_detail: Otter API and Webhooks appear only on the Enterprise plan, which requires scheduling a demo.
